crossRefs.note: Don’t be afraid, little flock, for it is your Father’s good pleasure to give you the Kingdom.
“He said to him, ‘Well done, you good servant! Because you were found faithful with very little, you shall have…
Most certainly I tell you that he will set him over all that he has.
Then the King will tell those on his right hand, ‘Come, blessed of my Father, inherit the Kingdom prepared for you from…
Every man who strives in the games exercises self-control in all things. Now they do it to receive a corruptible crown…
Our hope for you is steadfast, knowing that, since you are partakers of the sufferings, so you are also of the comfort.
If we endure, we will also reign with him. If we deny him, he also will deny us.
Listen, my beloved brothers. Didn’t God choose those who are poor in this world to be rich in faith, and heirs of the…
When the chief Shepherd is revealed, you will receive the crown of glory that doesn’t fade away.
The wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve Apostles of the Lamb.

translations.web: I confer on you a kingdom, even as my Father conferred on me,
translations.bsb: And I bestow on you a kingdom, just as My Father has bestowed one on Me,
translations.kjv: And I appoint unto you a kingdom, as my Father hath appointed unto me;
translations.asv: and I appoint unto you a kingdom, even as my Father appointed unto me,
